## Summary

What this pull request delivers and why, in two or three sentences.

## Commits

- `type(scope): description`: one line on what the commit does.

## Validation

- Local: the commands run on the exact head and their results.
- CI: the required checks and their status.
- Manual: real-environment checks performed, or why none were needed.

## Review

The independent review verdicts that cover this head, and how their findings were resolved.

## Risks and follow-ups

Known limitations, proof that happens after merge, and work deliberately left for later. Write `None.` when there are none.
